risk_states.within_limits: No hard breaches or warnings; paper new entries remain allowed.
risk_states.monitor: No hard breaches, but one or more metrics are near a configured limit or a mark is missing.
risk_states.reduce_risk: One or more hard limits are breached; paper new entries are paused and risk reduction is recommended.

safety.description: M123 evaluates paper portfolio state against paper risk limits only. It does not call broker order APIs, submit orders, transmit orders, or mutate a real portfolio.
